name: my baby needs blood
source:
The seasons no longer follow their rhythm – winters bite harder now. A man and a woman walk the remnants of a fading land. There’s little left to hold onto...

[From [url=https://crotovane.itch.io/my-baby-needs-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四季不再循着往昔的节律更替——如今的寒冬愈发刺骨凛冽。一男一女跋涉在垂死大地的残迹之上。世间已所剩无几，难觅可堪依凭之物……

[摘自[url=https://crotovane.itch.io/my-baby-needs-blood]itch.io[/url]]
